title: BattINFO Cell Spec (Schema.org-Aligned Product)
description: The datasheet-level description of a cell model: identity, format, chemistry, construction, and nominal or rated properties (schema.org Product terms with battery extensions).

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

id.description: Canonical IRI of this cell spec.

identifier.description: Additional identifier(s) for the cell model, as strings or PropertyValue pairs.

name.description: Human-readable display name, typically manufacturer plus model.

manufacturer.description: Organization that manufactures this cell model.

brand.description: Brand the cell is marketed under, when different from the manufacturer.

additional_type.description: Extra JSON-LD type IRIs or labels stacked onto the record's @type.

product_type.description: Whether this cell spec is a commercial product, a research cell, or a prototype.

iec_code.description: IEC designation code (IEC 60086 / IEC 61960), when defined.

country_of_origin.description: Country where the cell is manufactured.

rechargeable.description: Whether this cell is rechargeable (true) or primary/single-use (false).

year.description: Year the cell model was released or the datasheet was issued.

chemistry.description: Overall cell chemistry label (e.g. 'Li-ion', 'NiMH', 'Zn-MnO2'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

positive_electrode_basis.description: Positive-electrode active material basis (e.g. 'LFP', 'NMC811'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

negative_electrode_basis.description: Negative-electrode active material basis (e.g. 'graphite', 'LTO', 'Si-C'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

datasheet_revision.description: Revision label of the datasheet the spec was taken from.

manufacturing_place.description: Geographic location of the battery manufacturing plant (EU Battery Regulation Annex VI Part A).

battery_category.description: Battery category per EU Battery Regulation Article 3.

cell_configuration.description: Electrode configuration as built. Optional; absent means unstated (read as a full cell unless a reference_electrode is present). Stated explicitly it overrides that heuristic: half_cell types the JSON-LD as BatteryHalfCell + HalfCellDevice, three_electrode_cell as ThreeElectrodeCellDevice, full_cell suppresses both.

cell_spec.description: Identity and classification of the cell design.

properties.description: Datasheet-style quantitative properties of the cell model; each key holds a SpecItem quantity. Dimension keys follow the format rules: diameter for cylindrical and coin, length/width/thickness for prismatic and pouch, height for all.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from. Recommended values: datasheet, manufacturer, curated, literature, manual, other.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file, for integrity verification.

workflow_version.description: Version of the ingest/curation workflow that produced this record.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

curated_by.description: Name or identifier of the person who curated this record.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

subject_of.description: Publications (papers, reports) that study or document this cell model.

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

specification_comment.description: Verbatim comment lines carried over from the source specification.

editorial.description: Internal editorial metadata — review status and curation notes. Ignored by the publish pipeline; not forwarded to the registry semantic payload.

construction.description: Internal construction: assembly type, layering, sheet counts, and electrode-assembly geometry.

positive_electrode.description: Inline description of the positive electrode (coating, current collector, tab, properties).

negative_electrode.description: Inline description of the negative electrode (coating, current collector, tab, properties).

working_electrode.description: Inline working-electrode structure. Role holder for a half_cell or three_electrode_cell: a cell that is not a full cell has no positive/negative polarity to assign, so the electrode under study is the working electrode. Emitted as hasWorkingElectrode with @type WorkingElectrode.

counter_electrode.description: Inline counter-electrode structure. Role holder for a half_cell or three_electrode_cell. In a half cell the counter electrode also serves as the reference, so it is emitted with @type [CounterElectrode, ReferenceElectrode]; in a three-electrode cell the separate reference_electrode field carries the reference role.

electrolyte.description: Inline electrolyte description (family, salt, solvents, additives).

separator.description: Inline separator description (material, structure, coating, and properties).

housing.description: Inline housing description (case, cap, terminals, seals, parts).

positive_electrode_spec_id.description: IRI of the standalone electrode-spec used as the positive electrode of this cell model; may be given instead of, or alongside, the inline positive_electrode holder.

negative_electrode_spec_id.description: IRI of the standalone electrode-spec used as the negative electrode of this cell model; may be given instead of, or alongside, the inline negative_electrode holder.

working_electrode_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of a standalone electrode-spec for the working electrode (used instead of, or alongside, the inline working_electrode holder).

counter_electrode_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of a standalone electrode-spec for the counter electrode.

electrolyte_spec_id.description: IRI of the standalone electrolyte-spec used in this cell model; may be given instead of, or alongside, the inline electrolyte holder.

separator_spec_id.description: IRI of the standalone separator-spec used in this cell model; may be given instead of, or alongside, the inline separator holder.

housing_spec_id.description: IRI of the standalone housing-spec used in this cell model; may be given instead of, or alongside, the inline housing holder.

hazardous_substances.description: Hazardous substances present in the battery (EU Battery Regulation Annex XIII §7.1).

cas_number.description: CAS Registry Number of the substance.

concentration_ppm.description: Concentration in parts per million by weight.

critical_raw_materials.description: Critical raw materials present in the battery at more than 0.1% weight by weight (EU Battery Regulation Annex XIII §7.1).

name.description: Material name, per the EU critical raw materials list.

weight_fraction.description: Mass fraction of the material in the battery (0-1).

extinguishing_agent.description: Usable extinguishing agent for the battery (EU Battery Regulation Annex VI Part A).

license.description: License under which this record and its data are released, as an SPDX license identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a license URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Distinct from data authorship (creators).

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

author.description: Author list as a formatted string.

BibliographyEntry.description: A publication that documents or studies the described item.

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

Identifier.description: One or more identifiers: plain strings and/or PropertyValue pairs naming the identifier scheme.

property_id.description: Identifier scheme or property IRI the value belongs to.

PropertyValue.description: An identifier value qualified by the scheme it belongs to (schema.org PropertyValue).

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this manufacturer to its organization record.

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this brand to its organization record.

Brand.description: A brand, with an optional canonical organization IRI for the brand owner.

BrandOrOrganization.description: Either a Brand or an Organization object.

OrganizationIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the organization/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/organization/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

id.description: Resolvable IRI of the grant (e.g. a CORDIS project IRI).

identifier.description: Grant number as assigned by the funder (e.g. '101069765').

same_as.description: External identifier IRI for the funder (e.g. a ROR or DOI funder IRI).
External identifier IRI, typically an ORCID (https://orcid.org/...).

affiliation.description: Organization the person is affiliated with.

Person.description: A person, in schema.org Person terms; an ORCID may be given in same_as.
